snippet.title: The Membrane - Demo Update Trailer
snippet.description:
Shoot, slash and slay the enemy hordes erupting from the jungle’s Membrane in this action survival roguelite. Hold the encircling trenches, fortify them, choose your build and rise from loinclothed-servant to unstoppable Amazon king.

Play the demo:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4558570/The_Membrane/

DEMO UPDATE: 

- New enemy and wave type
- 2 New Bosses
- 4 New boons

And a lot more possibilities for unique runs and builds and to experience.
